argument: For simpler accelerator control problems, a framework using a learnable physics-based surrogate achieves comparable performance to a standard model-free RL algorithm, while for more challenging tasks it achieves superior performance at minimizing operational hazards while maintaining target energy gain.
boundary: Evidence is limited to the reported accelerator control tasks and the specific RL framework; transfer to other systems or tasks is unestablished.
claim: For simpler accelerator control problems, a framework using a learnable physics-based surrogate achieves comparable performance to a standard model-free RL algorithm, while for more challenging tasks it achieves superior performance at minimizing operational hazards while maintaining target energy gain.
